title: krag Domain Lexicon
description: Project-specific terminology glossary. Each key is a term, each value is its definition. Terms are matched case-insensitively against query text using word-boundary regex.

examples.kragd: The krag service daemon — a FastAPI server that loads models once and serves queries over HTTP on port 8742
examples.krag-direct: The in-process CLI entry point that runs without the kragd service, loading models per-command
examples.RRF: Reciprocal Rank Fusion — a score merging algorithm that combines ranked results from multiple retrieval sources
examples.LLM pool: The component managing text and code LLMs with hot-swap or simultaneous loading depending on VRAM
examples.named vector space: A Qdrant feature allowing multiple embedding vectors per point, each from a different model
examples.prompt preset: A named configuration (strict, balanced, verbose, code) that bundles system prompts with generation parameters
examples.VRAM: Video RAM on the GPU, shared between embedding models and LLMs — managed via hot-swap to avoid exhaustion
